name: serper-live
description: Live Google search results, domain positions and open markets via the Serper.live SERP API.
long_description:
Run a real Google search for the country, language and device you choose and check where a domain ranks right now. Every search is fresh: nothing is cached, and a page of 10 results usually comes back in 2–3 seconds. Positions count organic results only, without ads, sitelinks, video or image blocks.

Searches are billed to your [Serper.live](https://serper.live) balance per page of up to 10 organic results ([pricing](https://serper.live/pricing)); listing the open markets is free. Create an API token at [serper.live/account/tokens](https://serper.live/account/tokens) and enter it when installing.

tools.name: google_search
tools.description: Live organic Google results for a keyword, country, language and device, up to 100 per call. Billed per page of up to 10 results.

tools.name: domain_position
tools.description: Where a domain ranks in Google for a keyword in a country and on a device; every position if it appears more than once. Billed like google_search.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Markets open right now and the default Google language of each. Free.

token.title: API token
token.description: Serper.live API token (sl_live_…) from https://serper.live/account/tokens. Searches are billed to the balance of its account.
